method: Estimated age = 0.39 × words per sentence + 11.8 × syllables per word − 10.59. Standalone task lines count as sentence units. Syllables use a fixed dictionary and vowel-group heuristic inherited from the reference pack. This is a text estimate, not an assessment of a learner. Headings, codes, dates and staff notes excluded. Short vocabulary labels and stems are taught with their numbered symbols.
